source: v97 captured post_receive_capture_context for 10/20/30 frames but contact_teacher_active became false immediately after first receiver foot collision; strike_phase.begin_capture suppresses teacher torque until STRIKE phase.
hypothesis: While a measured receiver post-contact buffer is active, permit the bounded receive teacher through the strike-phase gate, without bypassing motor, option, joint, safety or robot-contact guards. This should produce nonzero teacher torque in capture frames and may retain the ball for a second shot.
paired_parent: v97 corresponding hold length, same consumed scenes; paired comparison only, not Fresh
authority_gate: 3/3 receiver first-foot contacts, post_receive_capture_context active, and nonzero measured contact_teacher_peak_torque_nm on at least 3 subsequent capture frames.
positive_sample_gate: Authority gate plus 3/3 six-G1 safe clean foot transfers, no early nonfoot ball contact, no robot collision, and at least 2/3 later receiver foot shots >=0.20 s after first touch with outgoing speed >=2.0 m/s. Otherwise reject. Privileged teacher data cannot be directly promoted.
interpretation: This tests control-plane priority and physical receive reachability, not learned skill.
